description: Cut the three APK foundation mechanics over to public game identities, prove every public game and edition in the QC and consuming hosts, and produce exact legacy deletion evidence while preserving the stable vocabulary, sentence, and GameResults ABI.
deviation_notes: Implementation commit 8b98aed0 completed the automated W0 work and product-owner approval was recorded in a8f28029. The foundation intentionally used mechanic-oriented IDs; W0 replaces those public IDs without compatibility aliases while retaining mechanic module filenames and pure gameplay helpers internally.

sprint.goal: Publish the first three APK games under product identities and prove they can be QCed and consumed without copied gameplay code or educational-contract drift.
sprint.demo_notes: Accepted at a8f28029 after implementation 8b98aed0: exact public IDs, all-three host registries, all-three-by-two-edition browser coverage, unchanged educational ABI, and a validated 55-path legacy disposition manifest.
